name: vllm-cuda-4090
description: Upstream official vllm/vllm-openai image, mirrored on the 4090 box (x86_64). NVIDIA RTX 4090 (sm_89 / Ada) is a standard consumer GPU fully supported by the stock vllm-openai CUDA build (no special PTX/wheel needed, unlike DGX Spark sm_121). The dispatcher runs it with --entrypoint /bin/bash so the unit's own `vllm serve ...` command takes over. daily.sh nv4090 mirrors this via mirror_pkg with an explicit vllm/vllm-openai source.
